Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: ArgentBank security handoff — evidence, retention & next steps

Hi Ellis — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single decision log to track. I captured what I heard; please correct anything I’ve mis-stated.

Summary of what we covered
- Primary drivers: regulated payments flows, auditability for ACH/settlements, and DLP requirements for customer PII.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 in-progress evidence), audit log export capability (queryable by time range), retention policy for logs (24 months preferred; 12 months minimum), and penetration test report or scheduled window.
- Data residency & DPA: ArgentBank needs an explicit DPA clause for audit logs and a retention schedule in the contract.
- Risk tolerance: Argent is comfortable with a compensating control for short-term (30d) KV-cache logs during peak ingestion if we commit to a plan to ingest full audit traces within 72 hours.

Proposed action items (owners + rough ETA)
1) Share preliminary SOC 2 scope table and mapping (Sofia) — attachment SOC2-Scope-Table.xlsx — by EOD Wed 5/20.
2) Security DDQ / artifact handoff (Argent security) — request: pen-test summary + SOC timeline — expected 2 weeks.
3) Retention decision: confirm 24 months or negotiate 12 -> (Ellis/Ben) — reply by 5/24.
4) Pen-test window: propose Redwood test window July 12–16; Argent to confirm vendor availability (Ben) — confirm by 6/4.
5) Legal: draft DPA redline with explicit retention clause (Redwood legal, copied to sales) — target 1 week after SOC artifacts land.

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Scope-Table.xlsx (attached), sample DPA redlines (DPA-redlines.docx, attached).

Next meeting: propose a 30-minute technical handoff with Argent security + Redwood syssec on May 26 (calendar invite pending).

Thanks — I’ll upload the SOC scope spreadsheet to the shared Drive folder and drop the link into HubSpot.

—

Thanks Sofia — this lines up with our notes. A couple of clarifications from our side: 
- Retention: 24 months is preferred but our legal team will accept 12 months with contractual guarantees around export and auditability. We will make a call by next Monday 5/24.
- SOC 2: we have a current Type II in-progress with a final report expected late June — security will share a cover note and the latest evidence bundle once it’s available.
- Pen test: Ben is our lead; I’ve looped him in to confirm vendor windows.

Hi Sofia — quick note from security: attaching a short pen-test summary (pen-test-summary.pdf) and our template for artifact handoff. A couple of asks: 
1) Please confirm the canonical location you’ll use for artifact upload (Drive link or SFTP). We prefer SFTP for high-sensitivity files; if Drive is used, we require org-level sharing restrictions.
2) Can Redwood provide a one-page description of how audit logs are exported (API endpoints + rate limits)? Security needs the export format to validate our retention/ingest assumptions.
3) DPA: I attached our preferred redline comments; legal will expect Redwood to take a look.

We’ll try to confirm retention stance (24m vs 12m) by Monday; if you can surface the SOC sections mapping this week it will speed legal review.

Thanks,

Thanks Ben / Ellis — appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. Finalizing the decision log below and next steps (owners + calendar items).

Decision log / commitments: 
- Retention: Argent to confirm 24/12 by 2026-05-24 (Ellis) — mitigation: Redwood will keep a rolling 30-day ingestion cache and full audit export available on request within 72 hours until retention is finalized.
- SOC 2: Argent will share the in-progress artifact bundle; Redwood will map artifacts to SOC sections and hand to Legal (Neha owner).
- Pen-test: Redwood proposes internal coordination week of July 12; Argent to confirm vendor or internal ownership (Ben).
- Artifact exchange method: preference is SFTP for high-sensitivity bundles. Sofia will provision a temporary SFTP endpoint and share credentials via our secure vault.

Immediate next actions (this week):
1) I will upload SOC2-Scope-Table.xlsx to the Drive folder and paste the link into HubSpot (complete: 5/20). Related HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deal/ARG-2026-34.

3) Marissa to send DPA redline draft to Argent legal by 5/24.
4) Schedule a 30-minute technical handoff with Ben & Security — proposed: Tue 5/26 10:00am ET (calendar invite sent).

If that all looks right I’ll mark the HubSpot deal with the compliance milestone and close out this discovery thread. Thanks all —
